propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the daily break-handling procedure for card-scheme settlement files and completed the control checklist before the treasury cut-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the daily procedure and the checklist directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate rewrote the reconciliation runbook after the tool migration and onboarded two new analysts with it.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the runbook work sample document the rewrite and the onboarding.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate's runbook rewrite made settlement breaks clear 40 percent faster.
propositions.rationale: The only figure is a phone-screen recollection of a meeting slide with no baseline, period or report; nothing in the materials measures time-to-clear.

expectedGap: No report, baseline or measurement in the materials shows a reduction in time-to-clear attributable to the candidate.
expectedBoundaryNote: Do not present the recollected meeting-slide figure as a delivered result; the materials document the procedure, the runbook and the escalations, not a measured improvement.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the monthly reconciliation report or the slide that shows time-to-clear before and after the runbook rewrite, with the period and the baseline.
